integrity: All 3..6 vertex graph cases exhaustively tested by included standard-library code and unbounded cases proved by exact combinatorial argument. Murray--Wilcher abstract is accessible but its full text was inaccessible; an earlier May issue-month thesis has no confirmed public day. No independent audit performed.
limitations: Only connected finite simple graphs, two ordered particles and the unsubdivided Abrams cubical model; extension to arbitrary continuous models, unordered quotients and higher particle counts is not claimed.
title: Compact-surface classification of ordered two-point graph configuration complexes
